experiment.mission: Controlled training-only geodesic direction auxiliary on mirrored family14 TRAIN levels
experiment.claim_scope: Metal simulated 20-second family14/15/16 bank evaluation only; no new-target simulator or Webots transfer claim.

configuration.auxiliary_loss: 0.1 * (1 - cosine(executed actor mean direction, normalized +gradient(Phi))) per valid row; minibatch mean
configuration.phi_definition: Phi=-geodesic_distance/30m, so +gradient(Phi) points toward the goal.
configuration.deployment_change: none; actor remains 184D and mode17/22 action map is unchanged.

preflight.interpretation: Labels matched actual mirrored TRAIN level IDs/worlds. The one-update actor-only diagnostic used zero PPO advantages/rewards and zero entropy coefficient, isolating the auxiliary gradient.

selection_summary.seed42: Control and auxiliary selected identical checkpoint hash; mirrored dev family14 remained 0/30, family15 11/30, family16 28/30.
selection_summary.seed43: Control and auxiliary selected identical checkpoint hash; mirrored dev family14 remained 0/30, family15 11/30, family16 28/30.
selection_summary.final_checkpoints: All four 600-rollout final actors had 0/30 family14 successes on dev. Collision/timeout splits and other-family outcomes varied by seed and treatment; they provide no consistent gain.

superseded_unmirrored_probe.runs: seed42 control and auxiliary, 600 rollouts each
superseded_unmirrored_probe.acceptance_use: excluded; the work predated the mirrored-bank correction and is retained only as a pilot/debug record.

verification.test_result: PASS: project suite plus geodesic direction gradient finite-difference max error 7.75605e-6; PPO toy error 0.587367->0.0399787.
verification.resume: Aux seed42 resumed after one initial rollout using v2 safeguard coefficient/field hash; legacy v1 readers remain restricted to coefficient zero.

experiment.decision: Do not adopt this auxiliary setting and do not increase its strength. The targets are valid and locally aligned, and one isolated update lowers actor direction loss, but PPO training does not produce held-out family14 success after 600 rollouts in either seed. The immediate direction objective is not sufficient to resolve the multi-turn route failure.
experiment.next_narrow_decision: Inspect per-stage policy progress through the second turn and determine whether updates preserve the first-turn gain before trying another learning signal. Keep these candidate checkpoints unselected.

source_review.mission: Read-only source/evidence audit of the geodesic direction auxiliary

prior_experiment.outcome: Auxiliary coefficient 0.1 had 0/30 family-14 DEV successes at both seeds after 600 rollouts; control and auxiliary selected identical DEV checkpoints per seed. Do not adopt or increase coefficient.

source_audit.pre_action_pose_and_level: Target kernel runs after sim_act but before sim_advance; sim_act leaves physical pose unchanged. It reads the active bank level before any terminal reset.
source_audit.gradient_sign: Phi=-geodesic_distance/cap; increasing Phi points goalward. The cosine-loss gradient sign and body-to-world transpose agree with finite-difference tests.
source_audit.actor_map: Auxiliary differentiates the mode-17/22 overhead gate and tanh translation map. It does not alter yaw, observations, reward, PPO log probability, or deployment.

compatibility_fix.issue: Safeguard v1 has no direction-field hash. With potential shaping active and direction auxiliary disabled, the loader compared the absent hash with the current field hash and rejected valid legacy resumes.
compatibility_fix.fix: Skip field-hash comparison only for v1 sidecars when auxiliary coefficient is zero. Continue to reject v1 sidecars when the auxiliary is active. PPO v9 still validates the potential-shaping field metadata.
compatibility_fix.scope: One conditional in safeguard validation. No broader source edit.

legacy_v1_shaped_resume.input: Copied mirrored-control-seed42 v9 checkpoint and replay sidecar plus a v1 safeguard header without a field hash
legacy_v1_shaped_resume.result: PASS; resumed at rollout 600, completed rollout 601, rewrote safeguard as v2

source_review.remaining_caveat: Auxiliary PPO loss is not included in the logged PPO policy-loss metric; current diagnostics report its coefficient and target count only.
